0022600147.text: The Utah Jazz (1-4, 13th in the West, currently on a three-game losing streak) host the Portland Trail Blazers (3-1, 5th in the West, on a one-game losing streak) in the Jazz's sixth game of the season. Out for Utah are Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), while Lauri Markkanen is day-to-day with a wrist injury and is a game-time decision; for Portland, Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness), Ja Morant (hamstring), and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery) are out, and Robert Williams III is day-to-day with a knee injury and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, but Utah lost all four meetings with Portland in 2025-26, most recently 124-114 in Portland on March 13, 2026.
